summary: Replace suitable TypeScript test assertions with intention-specific Shoehorn helpers while preserving fixture semantics and test coverage.

supporting_disposition.reason: Preserve source UI metadata and invocation policy.
Copy repository MIT license and attribution into derived package.

deltas.reason: Choose helpers by fixture intent rather than assertion syntax alone.
deltas.tradeoff: Migration is slower than blanket replacement.

deltas.reason: Explain that helpers neither populate omitted properties nor make deliberate invalid data safe.
deltas.tradeoff: The library benefit is narrower and more precise than a type-safe slogan.

deltas.reason: Keep complete fixtures and legitimate assertions when partial conversion weakens their purpose.

deltas.change: Validate behavior as well as types
deltas.reason: Run relevant tests, inspect assertions, and check production-import boundaries.
deltas.tradeoff: Requires more than the source final typecheck.

deltas.reason: Use the actual package manager and test/development placement appropriate to the project.
deltas.tradeoff: The install command varies instead of always using npm i.
